text:
incident-bot: PAGER: private-vpc cluster for AcmeCorp (us-west-2) - GPU pool exhausted, autoscaler failing to provision new nodes. Queue length: ~620, 90th pct latency spiking, ~15% 503 errors. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/priv-vpc-autoscale

sarah-ng: seeing same in grafana. spike started ~10:04 UTC. autoscaler logs show backoffs + 'maxNodesReached' and several imagePull backoffs.

mike-wu: confirmed. autoscaler attempted to launch 6 nodes at 10:06 but they stayed Pending, imagePull there are repeated errors: "BlobTooLarge" from internal registry for our custom AMI (customer-ami-123).

raj-patel: if AMI pulls are failing we won't get kubelet ready -> node not joining. Also noticed customer configured a hard node quota (maxNodes=12) on their private cluster, autoscaler respects that. Current active nodes: 12.

kelsey-w: paging oncall handoff in 20. I'll start mitigation: 1) attempt to evict low-priority batch pods to free GPUs, 2) instruct autoscaler to temporarily increase soft limit if possible, 3) coordinate with customer to push a smaller AMI or allow cache on registry.

leo-ops: eviction is risky because some long-running inference sessions are in flight for AcmeCorp. We can target non-customer critical jobs (internal test workloads). I'll run `kubectl get pods -n batch -o wide` and mark candidates.

sarah-ng: running audit of queue; majority are small (short) interactive requests for the Acme prod route. On-host metrics show GPU memory full on the pool (no evictable pods).

mike-wu: attempting manual node create via infra console to bypass autoscaler. Creating instance type g4dn.xlarge with pre-warmed image. If we can get one node we can drain some queue pressure.

incident-bot: NOTE: customer-impact tag applied. Affected customers: AcmeCorp (primary), a couple of smaller tenants on the same VPC. Severity: high for Acme real-time endpoints.

raj-patel: also saw repeated terraform apply errors earlier: rate-limit from registry (429) at 09:58 which matches a big customer AMI push. That may have caused partial image availability causing the imagePull backoff.

kelsey-w: update: I evicted internal-test pods (6 pods) -> freed 2 GPUs, queue dropped ~40 but still high. Manual node creation is still provisioning, stuck initialising due to imagePull timeout (30s).

leo-ops: trying a workaround: launching a node with the base public image (no customer AMI) and then manually pulling the model container. If that joins, we can shadow route some traffic to it.

mike-wu: successful join: node joined at 10:32 UTC using base image. Manually pulled model container and started a serving pod with `--node-selector=fast-path`. Started accepting traffic. Queue dropped ~200.

cust-success-bot: Notifying AcmeCorp support contact: "We are aware of elevated latency and 503s; working on mitigation. Will update in 30m." :phone: @Acmeops

sarah-ng: mitigation status: partial recovery. still seeing autoscaler failing to add new nodes because of two gating conditions: 1) customer maxNodes=12 (hard quota), 2) registry throttling causing AMI imagePull failure for additional nodes.

raj-patel: next steps: longer-term we need to (a) add logic to autoscaler to optionally bypass customer soft limits under emergency mode, (b) implement a cache/proxy for AMI artifacts in private regions, (c) enhance runbook to include immediate manual node creation with base images. Filing RFC for autoscaler emergency override.

kelsey-w: I'm opening a short-term tactical ticket to request AcmeCorp to relax their maxNodes in their control plane. Meanwhile infra will increase registry rate limit with vendor (support ticket created).

mike-wu: note for postmortem: traffic shaping could have prevented hitting the hard quota. Need better early warning when queue > 200 and activeNodes within 2 nodes of max.

sarah-ng: handoff to next on-call @ 11:00 UTC -> @raj-patel will take next 2 hours. I'll put a summary in pager duty.

raj-patel: taking over. Current state: partial mitigation in place (1 manual node + evictions). Queue ~380, 503s down to 5%. Continuing to monitor, pushing for registry fix and customer quota bump.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 (private-vpc-autoscale-ami-constraint). Priority: P1. Links: metrics, logs, runbook.

cust-success-bot: Update sent to AcmeCorp at 10:45 UTC. They acknowledged and are ok with temporary quota bump to 18 nodes while we stabilise.

le0-ops (note): typo in participant name earlier -> leo-ops.

raj-patel: accepted quota bump, initiating autoscaler reconfiguration to set maxNodes=18 for AcmeCorp cluster. Will monitor for clean join of new nodes.

mike-wu: new nodes created at 10:58, some still hitting imagePull errors; but now with registry vendor throttle increased, majority succeeded by 11:04. Queue at 11:06 ~ 120 and trending down.

sarah-ng: closing from active pager in 40m if steady. Postmortem owners: eng-runtime (autoscaler fix), eng-infra (registry caching), devex (runbook updates).

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 11:12 UTC. Monitoring mode enabled.

raj-patel: leaving a final note for postmortem: immediate causes = registry push/throttle + hard customer node quota; contributing = lack of emergency autoscaler override and insufficient early-warning for queue vs node headroom.

kelsey-w: thanks team. I'll follow-up with cust-success for a recap with Acme and schedule postmortem meeting. :white_check_mark:
